regime_context: Detector shows AI Infrastructure leading with a modest score and mixed trend health; a broad, narrowing eligible set (22/49) with no single dominant narrative. The validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate as drawdown control (gate_helps true), not momentum ranking — cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0. Given a directional accuracy of only 0.463 on 95 prior calls and several sub-themes sharing the same ETF proxy, I'll keep conviction low and lean mostly on trends that are both eligible (trend-confirmed) and have healthy breadth.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Infrastructure's breadth (now just 0.125) recovers toward 0.4+ while keeping its rank-1 lead — a recovery in breadth with the leader staying on top would suggest the AI theme is rebuilding participation, while breadth staying pinned near 0.1 while Energy Complex holds 0.6+ would mark a de-facto leadership handoff away from AI Infra. Retire this watch if AI Infra's breadth stays below 0.2 for another 10 sessions.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex sits at rank 2 with the strongest breadth among leaders (0.636 vs leader AI Infra's 0.125), a solid durability bar (0.62), and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.93 is below the 1.0-ish flags elsewhere). Its trend-gate eligibility is the supported leg: this is a staying-power play within a trend-confirmed theme, not a momentum return call.
evidence: eligible=trend gate true, so absolute trend remains intact and drawdown-controlled
breadth 0.636 is the highest among top-5 ranks, suggesting participation rather than narrow leadership
crowding_z 0.93 but crowded=false — a size-down caution at most, not exclusion
theses.dissent: Energy is cyclically sensitive and the detector shows the eligible set narrowing; if the broad tape rolls over, high-beta energy is often the first to give back the prior trend even with the gate intact.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its own 50-day moving average while the S&P 500 holds above its own

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks 3 with a full trend tag (hurst_tag 'trend'), the strongest durability bar among top ranks (0.75), and breadth 0.6 — a coherent, persistent trend. The crowding flag (crowding_z 1.61, crowded=true) is explicitly only a size-down signal, so I hold direction but would trim rather than add.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend, the only clean trend tag among top-5 leaders
durability_bar 0.75 exceeds headline 0.5 and most peers
crowded=true — per guardrails, a cap not a fade
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.61 is the highest in the top tier; if this is a late-stage move, the trend can unwind fast even while the absolute gate is still technically intact, producing a shake-out.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks below its 21-day moving average and stays there for three consecutive sessions

theses.subject: Magnificent Seven
theses.thesis: Mag7 is trend-tagged (hurst_tag 'trend') with a durability bar of 0.65 and healthy breadth (0.571), yet it is only rank 7 — leadership is broad at the top, so this is not a crowded consensus long. The trend gate is doing the work of keeping an index-heavy mega-cap proxy eligible, and breadth suggests the theme is not over-concentrated.
evidence: crowding_z 0.44, crowded=false — not in the reflexive-overbought zone
theses.dissent: Mag7 tracks the same mega-cap liquidity pool as the AI trade; if the dominant AI Infra narrative cracks on a single-name shock, this proxy catches the same air pocket regardless of its own trend tag.

falsifier.text: QQQ lags SPY by more than 3% over a rolling 10-day window
